From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thermion Labs vendor onboarding — W-8BEN-E and requested docs

Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the call today. Quick checklist and plan from our side so we’re aligned: 

1) Required for PO activation (staged):
  - Valid W-8BEN-E signed by an authorized sig (you’ve provided — thank you).
  - Evidence of tax registration / TIN (company extract is useful).
  - A bank letter or government-issued doc that ties the legal name to an active bank account — this is our preferred liveness proof for non-US payees.

2) If you can only provide one of the above immediately, we can do a conditional PO issuance: 50% milestone released after legal/tax docs, remaining 50% released once bank letter received. This is common for first-time international vendors.

3) DocuSign path: we’ll send a DocuSign request (Marissa will own) to confirm sig authority for the W-8 on file — that accelerates legal sign-off.

4) Timing: if you can supply the bank letter by EOD Tue (20 Oct), we can route the PO for approval the same week. Otherwise we’ll proceed with conditional PO as noted.

Marissa — can you confirm the DocuSign link and any additional procurement-side checklist we should send to Thermion?

Sean
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Hi Elena — looping in our tax ops checklist and the DocuSign link.

Attached: Procurement_Tax_Evidence_Checklist.pdf (PDF)
DocuSign: https://app.redwood.internal/docusign/qsj9n2  (signature request for W-8 confirmation)

Acceptable liveness docs (any one of):
- Bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account & legal name (scanned, bank stamp acceptable)
- Recent bank statement with bank header and company name (redact balances if necessary)
- Government-issued company certificate with recent timestamp (last 12 months)

If you cannot get a bank letter quickly, a notarized bank statement or a certified accountant letter (on firm letterhead) will work as an alternative. Remote notarization is acceptable but please include notarization certificate/email trail.

Action items for Thermion: attach bank letter to reply or sign the DocuSign by EOD Tue to avoid conditional PO. If you prefer the conditional PO flow, confirm so we can prepare PO terms.

Marissa Cole
Tax & Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
